# The Craftors

Website: https://the-craftors.vercel.app/

The Craftors is a web development and SEO service based in Port Harcourt, Rivers State, Nigeria. It helps businesses, professionals, creatives, and students build fast, accessible, search-friendly digital experiences.

## Services

- Business Website Development — Professional websites for businesses and service providers.
- Portfolio Website Development — Personal portfolio websites for professionals, creatives, developers, and students.
- Progressive Web Apps — Fast, installable web applications with app-like experiences.
- Web Application Development — Custom web software for business workflows and online services.
- SEO Optimization — SEO-friendly technical and content improvements for better search visibility and performance.

## Expertise

- Responsive website development
- Website performance
- Search engine optimization
- Accessible user interfaces
- Web applications
- Progressive Web Apps
- Transparent project pricing
- Remote project collaboration

## Location

Port Harcourt, Rivers State, Nigeria.

Remote clients outside Nigeria are welcome.
